body_html:
JAMMIN’ DJs travels all over Georgia hosting weddings, and Castle Rock is certainly included in that area! This was another awesome wedding and we had people dancing the whole time. Everyone was loving the rock and 80’s without a doubt, and we had an absolutely awesome couple of hours of dancing. Although this wedding the couple actually did a destination wedding, it is never too late to come back and have a reception upon the return. JAMMIN’ DJs takes care of that part for you and makes it a party – all they had to do was have the guests show up!

 

DJ Cameron
